说明: 修 bug、加功能和守规矩加代码质量（11-08 起）；R9 = 判对错 70% + 代码质量 30%。代码质量由独立评审（Claude，新开的子会话）只看随机甲乙标签的改动打分，打完才揭晓；评审没看过工具的对话和用时。

理由.结构与分层: 拆成 ExpenseDay、LocalMoney、ExpenseStore 与视图，日期、金额、数据、界面各管一块。
理由.可读性: 注释讲清本地正午、系统解析过宽等原因；parse 与 recentAdds 的 generation 逻辑偏密。
理由.一致性: KPI 卡、状态徽章、添加面板、页面加载都用 SW 组件，按文档在枚举末尾加 expenses。
理由.稳健写法: 整串严格解析金额、本地正午解析日期，处理取消与日期变更；每次解析都新建 NumberFormatter。
理由.可维护性: Large 阈值提成 largeAmountThreshold，三个地区各有 Preview；手写解析器偏长，未补测试。

理由_en.结构与分层: Split into ExpenseDay, LocalMoney, ExpenseStore and the views: dates, money, data and UI each in their own place.
理由_en.可读性: Comments explain parsing at local noon and why the system parser is too lenient; the generation logic in parse and recentAdds is dense.
理由_en.一致性: KPI cards, status badges, the add sheet and page loading all use SW components, and expenses is added at the end of the enum as the docs instruct.
理由_en.稳健写法: Strict whole-string amount parsing and local-noon date parsing, handles cancellation and date changes; creates a new NumberFormatter on every parse.
理由_en.可维护性: The Large threshold is a named largeAmountThreshold, with a Preview for each of three regions; the hand-written parser is long and no tests were added.

理由.结构与分层: ExpenseFormatting 包揽解析、日期、标签与月合计，store.log 还接收原始文本解析，层次略混。
理由.可读性: 正则校验金额与日期清楚，行布局易懂；isLoading、isSaving 守卫在 store 和视图各写一遍。
理由.一致性: SW 组件用法到位，但另起用 swiftc 单独编译运行的测试程序和 Tests/README.md，游离于工程之外。
理由.稳健写法: 显式 MainActor、防重复提交、日期回转校验到位；币种回退 XXX，每行新建 DateFormatter。
理由.可维护性: fetch、add 可注入便于测试且检查覆盖面广，但阈值 50 写死在视图里，测试要手动敲命令才能跑。

理由_en.结构与分层: ExpenseFormatting handles parsing, dates, labels and monthly totals at once, and store.log also takes raw text to parse; the layers are somewhat mixed.
理由_en.可读性: Regex validation of amounts and dates is clear and the row layout is easy to follow; the isLoading and isSaving guards are written twice, in the store and in the view.
理由_en.一致性: SW components are used correctly, but the tests are a separate program compiled with swiftc plus a Tests/README.md, outside the project.
理由_en.稳健写法: Explicit MainActor, double-submit guard and round-trip date validation; falls back to currency XXX and creates a DateFormatter for every row.
理由_en.可维护性: fetch and add are injectable and the checks cover a lot, but the threshold 50 is hard-coded in the view and the tests must be run by hand.
